newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions 4.606 bln rupees six-month bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions 4.606 bln rupees six-month bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Tuesday it had auctioned six-month short-term federal bonds worth 4.696 billion rupees at a weighted average yield of 17.29545 percent a year.
The bank received bids worth a total of 6.156 billion rupees out of which bids for 4.696 billion rupees were accepted.
In the previous auction held on April 7, bids worth 1.339 billion rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 17.06763 percent a year.
